mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over 3 months signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and boosting valuations, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decline is not sustained for 3 months, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than the 60-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE (unemployment rate) signals labor market strengthening, increasing consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decline is not sustained, or returns are not higher than baseline (p > 0.05 t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing above 2% in FEDFUNDS signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and lowering growth expectations, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS above 2% does not coincide with negative returns, or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) signal robust economic expansion, enhancing corporate profits and investor sentiment, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously over 3 months
failure_condition: If the proxies do not rise together, or returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If not in late-cycle regime, or FEDFUNDS decline does not coincide with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDPC1 (demand) alongside PAYEMS (employment) indicates strong consumer and business activity, driving up corporate earnings and stock prices, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and PAYEMS rise simultaneously over 3 months
failure_condition: If the proxies do not rise together, or returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing above 5% in UNRATE signals high unemployment, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE above 5% does not coincide with negative returns, or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO (supply index) indicates increased production capacity and lower inflationary pressures, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rise is not sustained, or returns are not positive over 60 days (p > 0.05).
